about: Emergency departments the sources lag on, checked by hand (owner, #298 and #300), each with its source and the date checked. "open": an ER CMS doesn't list yet, timed unless CMS has a hospital within 1 km. "closed": a CMS hospital that no longer has one, named by its CMS facility ID or by its name within 1 km of its coordinates, and never timed. Parcel screens and the area catalog both read it.
